Name: KPI SVG - Not Backordered vs Backordered (Conditional Color)
Expression:
VAR Total = [Order Total]
VAR BO = [Backordered $$]
VAR NotBO = Total - BO

VAR pct_BO = DIVIDE(BO, Total, 0)
VAR pct_NotBO = DIVIDE(NotBO, Total, 0)

VAR BarWidth = 320
VAR BarHeight = 32
VAR SVG_Height = 110

VAR LabelFontColor = "#000000"
VAR PercentFontColor = "#FFFFFF"
VAR NotBO_Color = "#4A5B73"
// Conditionally format Backordered bar color
VAR BO_Color = IF(pct_BO > 0.1, "#D45353", "#808080")

VAR TitleText = "Not Backordered vs. Backordered"
VAR TitleFontSize = 15

VAR NotBO_Dollar_Label = FORMAT(NotBO, "$#,0")
VAR BO_Dollar_Label = FORMAT(BO, "$#,0")

VAR NotBO_Percent_Label = FORMAT(pct_NotBO, "0%")
VAR BO_Percent_Label = FORMAT(pct_BO, "0%")

// X positions
VAR LabelMargin = 4
VAR NotBO_Label_X = LabelMargin + 1
VAR BO_Label_X = BarWidth - LabelMargin - 1
VAR Title_X = BarWidth / 2

// Y positions
VAR Title_Y = 22
VAR DollarLabels_Y = 54
VAR Bar_Y = 75
VAR PercentLabel_Y = Bar_Y + (BarHeight / 2) + 6

// Bar segment widths
VAR NotBO_Width = ROUND(pct_NotBO * BarWidth, 0)
VAR BO_Width = BarWidth - NotBO_Width

// X positions for percent labels (centered in each bar segment)
VAR NotBO_Percent_X = NotBO_Width / 2
VAR BO_Percent_X = NotBO_Width + (BO_Width / 2)

VAR SVG =
    "<svg width='" & BarWidth & "' height='" & SVG_Height & "' viewBox='0 0 " & BarWidth & " " & SVG_Height & "' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>" &
        // Title (centered at top)
        "<text x='" & Title_X & "' y='" & Title_Y & "' text-anchor='middle' font-size='" & TitleFontSize & "' fill='" & LabelFontColor & "' font-family='Segoe UI' font-weight='bold'>" &
            TitleText &
        "</text>" &
        // Not Backordered $ label (above bar, far left)
        "<text x='" & NotBO_Label_X & "' y='" & DollarLabels_Y & "' text-anchor='start' font-size='13' fill='" & LabelFontColor & "' font-family='Segoe UI' font-weight='bold'>" &
            NotBO_Dollar_Label &
        "</text>" &
        // Backordered $ label (above bar, far right)
        "<text x='" & BO_Label_X & "' y='" & DollarLabels_Y & "' text-anchor='end' font-size='13' fill='" & LabelFontColor & "' font-family='Segoe UI' font-weight='bold'>" &
            BO_Dollar_Label &
        "</text>" &
        // Not Backordered Bar (bottom)
        "<rect x='0' y='" & Bar_Y & "' width='" & NotBO_Width & "' height='" & BarHeight & "' fill='" & NotBO_Color & "' />" &
        // Backordered Bar (bottom, conditional color)
        "<rect x='" & NotBO_Width & "' y='" & Bar_Y & "' width='" & BO_Width & "' height='" & BarHeight & "' fill='" & BO_Color & "' />" &
        // Not Backordered percent label (inside bar)
        IF(
            NotBO_Width > 28,
            "<text x='" & NotBO_Percent_X & "' y='" & PercentLabel_Y & "' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='" & PercentFontColor & "' font-family='Segoe UI' font-weight='bold'>" &
                NotBO_Percent_Label &
            "</text>",
            ""
        ) &
        // Backordered percent label (inside bar)
        IF(
            BO_Width > 28,
            "<text x='" & BO_Percent_X & "' y='" & PercentLabel_Y & "' text-anchor='middle' font-size='15' fill='" & PercentFontColor & "' font-family='Segoe UI' font-weight='bold'>" &
                BO_Percent_Label &
            "</text>",
            ""
        ) &
    "</svg>"

RETURN
    "data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & SVG
